# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My pick for most people: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-$150)**
- It's rated IP68 (dust-tight and submersible), with about 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost). It also works as a power bank.
- What Hi-Fi named it best overall, and Best Products did too. Best Products lists it at $150 (25% off $200), and What Hi-Fi listed it at $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon.
- Where to buy: [What Hi-Fi's review](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) and [Best Products' review](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) both link to the retailers.

**Other good options**

| Need | Pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Big pool party | JBL Boombox 4 | RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, gets loud, and lasts 40+ hours. Its sound is narrow, so it's muffled off to the sides. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth) |
| Best sound in all directions | Ultimate Ears Epicboom | 360° sound, IP67, floats, about 15 hours. It's the top pick at Tom's Guide and RTINGS' mid-range pick. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) |
| Budget | Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 | About the size of a softball, IP67, floats, 14 hours. Best Products lists it at $65 (down from $80). [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) |
| Cheapest | JBL Go 5 | About $40, IP67, but only about 8 hours of battery. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) |
| Easy to carry | JBL Grip | Can-sized and under a pound, IP68, 12 hours, about $100. Good Housekeeping's best overall. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/) |
| Loud, floating boombox | Soundcore Boom 2 Plus | 100 W, IPX7, floats, up to 20 hours (with lights off). It's heavy at 3.8 kg and lists at $249.99, or $200 with code AFSC20 per Dealectric. [Buy at Soundcore (affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus) |

**Beach tips**
- IP ratings cover water and dust, not salt or chlorine. Rinse the speaker with fresh water afterward if the manual allows it, because fabric-covered speakers wear faster. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- Keep the speaker on a towel instead of burying it in sand, and close the charging-port flap. Dry it fully before charging. [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers-for-the-beach-pool-and-shower/)
- Aim for IP67 or higher. A "floats" feature is useful at the pool.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want something pocketable or party-loud, I can narrow it to one.
